findings.description: deriveNextCommand returns NextCommand objects without the icon field at every return site (brainstorming, brainstorm-ready, planning, plan-ready, implementing, reviewing/review-fix, replan-pending, blocked). The predicate table in plan.md prescribes specific emoji icons per stage and the NextCommand interface includes an optional icon field. Optional typing keeps the build green but UI/MCP consumers receive icon-less commands, breaking the shared contract.
findings.resolution: Added icon field to every NextCommand return site per predicate table. Tests updated to assert icon.
findings.suggestedFix: Add the icon field to each returned NextCommand per the plan's predicate table (brainstorming: light bulb, brainstorm-ready: clipboard, planning: pencil, plan-ready: rocket, implementing: gear, reviewing/review-fix: magnifier, replan-pending: refresh arrows, blocked: wrench) and update derive-next-command.test.mjs expected objects to assert icon presence.

findings.description: The Derive Command section in .claude/skills/work-on/SKILL.md instructs to print 'null' and stop when --dry-run is passed and the helper returns null, before the Null Handling section runs. As a result, --dry-run on a shipped task prints 'null' instead of 'task is already done' with mergeCommit, and --dry-run on a non-shipped stage with missing artifacts prints 'null' instead of the required "cannot derive command for stage '<stage>' — required artifact ..." error. This contradicts the plan's Null Handling contract and Verification cases B/D.
findings.resolution: Reordered: --dry-run short-circuit now after Null Handling, gated on command !== null.
findings.suggestedFix: Reorder: evaluate Null Handling first when the helper returns null (shipped message or missing-artifact error). Only when the helper returns a non-null NextCommand should --dry-run short-circuit and print the command string. Concretely: move the 'If --dry-run was passed, print and stop' clause to AFTER the null branches and gate it on command !== null.

findings.description: scripts/lib/derive-next-command.mjs uses `void task` at line 17 to suppress the unused-parameter signal, but the predicate body never reads task. The plan documents task as part of the signature for future seed-prompt fallback, but that fallback is implemented in the /work-on skill body, not the predicate. Either drop the parameter or replace the void trick with a JSDoc note like '@param task currently unused; reserved for future expansion'.
findings.resolution: Replaced void task with JSDoc note; parameter kept in signature per public contract.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace `void task` with a JSDoc comment explaining that the parameter is reserved for future task-level fallback; or remove the parameter from the signature and from derive-next-command-cli.mjs:28 and the test calls.
